第197章 任务抵达阴阳御奴宗（第1页）
任务，抵达阴阳御奴宗。（任务，抵达阴阳御奴宗。（第22页）他炼气境界的女奴大部分都安排在这边，而筑基境界的，则是跟着他一起进入阴阳御奴宗内。他在阴阳御奴宗内也有独属的山峰修炼之地，毕竟母亲可是金丹修士，自己也是筑基九层。很快，一行人乘坐城中传送阵，抵达阴阳御奴宗内。抵达之后，阴墨安排人将自己的女奴带到他专属的修炼场地而去，他则是对着赖沐开口道：“走吧，沐儿，你随我前往宗门登记处。”“是，师尊。”阴墨御剑而去，顾景元控制的分身赖沐跟着。“趁着赶路，我先大致说一下情况。”闻言，顾景元立刻点头，一副聆听教诲的模样。阴墨见状，也是很是满意，紧接着继续道：“阴阳御奴宗之中，一共六大主峰。我所在的乃是奴心峰，我母亲阴渡月便是峰主，金丹修士。我们这一脉相比其他五脉，算是垫底的存在。只有我母亲和陆师姐是金丹修士，还都是金丹初期修士。”阴墨神色微暗，但很快又一扫而空，继续道：“但也正因为如此，我们占据一峰资源，人均分配的也比其他峰多。而且我母亲金丹初期圆满在即，中期不远。陆师姐天赋出众，修为进展很快。这次若不是为了收你，我此刻也正在闭关。我如今筑基九层中期，要不了多久我也能走到冲击金丹境界的关口。”“师尊天资卓绝，定然能突破金丹境界。”顾景元开口恭维，但心中也是冷笑。金丹境界哪有这么好冲击的，而且对方说的陆师姐，大概率就是陆妩，可早就死在他手中了。闻言，阴墨哈哈大笑一声，紧接着又微微一叹，道：“金丹境界，何其艰难。哪怕我有金丹修士的母亲，也身怀烛灵体，可在没有凝金丹的情况下，突破的把握也不超过一半。”说着，视线落在顾景元身上，笑着道：“不过你不一样。我的烛灵体只是较为下等的灵体，在双修一道上能带来增益，若得阳属性宝物，也能加快修为提升进度，但终究有限。你的幽水灵体乃是中等灵体，更重要的是，这灵体和宗门的阴灵长河契合，你后面修炼定然极快，到时候冲击金丹境界的可能性或许比我还大。”顾景元：“再快也是需要时间的，等我达到筑基圆满的时候，师尊早已是金丹修士了。”“希望吧。”阴墨语气淡淡，然后接着开口：“这次登记之后，你作为我的弟子，直接便是核心弟子身份。会有一次选择顶级功法，三次选择上品功法法术秘籍的机会。顶级功法我建议你选择‘玄阴控水诀’或者‘寒水蚀心功’，至于镇峰功法，你暂时就不要想了。镇峰功法需要足够的功劳，还需要在宗门带的足够久，当然若是天灵根天才，那就另当别论了。”顾景元神情不变，点头道：“弟子明白。”“嗯，至于阴灵长河，乃是那些修炼阴寒水属性功法的修炼圣地，对于那些修炼双修功法的女子来说，更是一处极佳的修炼场所，可借助功法之威，快速积蓄庞大阴灵之力，为后续双修提供强大助益。要进入其中修炼最次也得是内门弟子，不仅需要贡献点，而且还有时长限制。而核心弟子则是没有时间限制，但筑基初期每天需要三十贡献点。”“我到时候会给你转两千贡献点，后面的你就需要自己想办法去完成任务获取了。而我接下来也会闭关，若是有问题，到时候可以去请教奴心峰的长老，我会打好招呼的。”顾景元点头：“多谢师尊，弟子定会努力修炼。”阴墨摆了摆手，眼中却是闪过一丝诡异的光芒。

Chapter 197 The mission arrives at the Yin Yang Royal Slave Sect (page 1)
The mission is to arrive at the Yin Yang Yunu Sect. (The mission is to arrive at the Yin Yang Yu Slave Sect. (Page 22) Most of his female slaves in the Qi Refining Realm are arranged here, while those in the Foundation Establishment Realm follow him into the Yin Yang Yu Slave Sect. He also has his own mountain training place in the Yin Yang Yu Slave Sect. After all, his mother is a Jindan monk, and she is also at the ninth level of Foundation Establishment. Soon, a group of people took the teleportation array in the city and arrived at the Yin Yang Yu Slave Sect. After arriving, Yin Mo arranged for his female slaves to be transported to the Yin Yang Yu Slave Sect. He took the slave to his exclusive training ground, and he said to Lai Mu: "Let's go, Mu'er, you follow me to the sect registration office." "Yes, Master." Yinmo left with his sword, and the clone Lai Mu controlled by Gu Jingyuan followed. "While I'm on my way, let me briefly explain the situation." Upon hearing this, Gu Jingyuan nodded immediately, as if he was listening to the instructions. Yin Mo was also very satisfied when he saw this, and then continued: "In the Yin Yang Yu Slave Sect, there is a man. There are six main peaks. The one I am in is the Nuxin Peak, and my mother Yin Duyue is the peak leader. Compared to the other five, our lineage is considered to be at the bottom. Only my mother and Senior Sister Lu are early stage Jindan monks." Yin Mo looked dim, but quickly cleared it up, and continued: "But because of this, we occupy one peak and have more resources per capita than other peaks. Completion is imminent, and the middle stage is not far away. Senior Sister Lu has outstanding talent, and her cultivation is progressing very quickly. If I hadn't taken you in this time, I would be in retreat now. I am now in the middle stage of the ninth level of foundation building, and it won't be long before I reach the point where I can break through to the Jin Dan state. Lu Wu had died in his hands a long time ago. Hearing this, Yin Mo laughed loudly, and then sighed slightly and said: "The realm of Jindan is so difficult. Even if I have a mother who is a Jindan monk and is pregnant with a candle spirit body, without the gold condensation pill, the chance of breakthrough is not more than half." After saying that, his eyes fell on Gu Jingyuan, and he said with a smile: "But you are different. My candle spirit body is just a lower level spirit body in the dual cultivation path. It can bring benefits, and if you get Yang attribute treasures, it can also speed up the progress of your cultivation, but it is ultimately limited. Your Nether Water Spirit Body is a medium spirit body. More importantly, this spirit body is consistent with the sect's Yin Spirit River. You will practice later. It will definitely be very fast, and the possibility of reaching the Golden Core realm may be greater than mine." Gu Jingyuan: "No matter how fast it is, it will take time. By the time I reach the perfection of foundation building, Master will already be a Golden Core cultivator." "I hope. "Yin Mo said calmly, and then continued: "After registering this time, you will become my core disciple. You will have three opportunities to choose the top-level skills and secrets. For the top-level skills, I suggest you choose the 'Xuanyin Water Control Technique' or the 'Cold Water Erosion Heart Technique'. As for the Zhenfeng Skill, you should not think about it for the time being. Of course, if you are a Tianlinggen genius, then it is a different matter." Gu Jingyuan's expression remained unchanged and he nodded: "Disciple understands." "Well, as for the Yinling River, it is a holy place for those who practice Yinhan water attributes. For those women who practice dual cultivation techniques, it is an excellent training place. They can use the power of the techniques to quickly accumulate huge Yin spirit power, which will provide powerful assistance for subsequent dual cultivation.Inner disciples not only need to contribute points, but also have a time limit. There is no time limit for core disciples, but they need thirty contribution points per day in the early stages of foundation building. "I will transfer 2,000 contribution points to you at that time, and you will have to find a way to complete the task and obtain it later." And I will also retreat next. If you have any questions, you can ask the elders of Nuxin Peak for advice. I will say hello. Gu Jingyuan nodded: "Thank you Master, I will definitely practice hard." "Yin Mo waved his hand, but a strange light flashed in his eyes.
